approval_scope: Technical readiness to publish only the exact Czech vstupenky.online 1.0.1 ZIP after the repository-required external review. This is not evidence that public ZIP/feed URLs are currently available, and is not JED approval.

findings_resolutions.finding: First native publication had previously been replaced by direct seed writes.
findings_resolutions.resolution: Final full suite creates and publishes a new module using native Joomla selection/forms/controllers, reads back the public position, inserts the new ID through native article save, and restores the three-instance baseline on both CMS versions.

findings_resolutions.finding: Article cache and helper mode assertions previously had masking/coverage gaps.
findings_resolutions.resolution: Actual article-only dispatcher pages pass all four mode/style combinations on cold and warm cache for both CMS versions; fixed/no-style has zero helper scripts.

findings_resolutions.finding: Browser checks previously did not prove modal disappearance or new-tab navigation.
findings_resolutions.resolution: Final browser test asserts map controls disappear after Escape and keyboard fallback opens the actual expected URL in a new tab.

findings_resolutions.finding: Startup and packaging/evidence could previously race or drift.
findings_resolutions.resolution: Bounded CLI/config/version/HTTP readiness is implemented. Immutable digest ZIPs and a successful full frozen-input verification bind 34 source/tool/test files and 13 result receipts to the exact Czech archive. Independently recomputed final hashes match.

findings_resolutions.finding: Distribution metadata and updater were previously absent or unproven.
findings_resolutions.resolution: Only Czech1.0.1 gains the update channel. Candidate/product/tag/URL/manifest/feed cross-checks are implemented; real Joomla discovery, download, SHA-256 and installer preserve settings on both CMS versions. Public transport remains a separately recorded effect.

findings_resolutions.finding: Prior403 probes and production service compatibility were unresolved.
findings_resolutions.resolution: Same-client header comparison records default Python-urllib403/error1010 versus descriptive probe200. Seven actual resources pass content checks. Separate unmapped headless browser confirms real legal/support pages and actual installed Joomla to real production form at320px with1019px auto-height and opening/closing the map, zero orders and zero seats selected.

findings_resolutions.finding: Release documentation needed to distinguish reviewed candidate, publication and catalog approval.
findings_resolutions.resolution: Final README, SUBMISSION and release notes clearly identify the Czech release, updater limitations, supported verified versions, manual first upgrade from local1.0.0, GPL/service boundaries and separate public/JED steps.

external_publication_prerequisites: Obtain the repository-required PR approval and merge the reviewed source to authoritative main; do not bypass branch protection.

Publish the sealed Czech release asset and stable feed, then pass release-gate.py --public against actual public bytes and verify the public update channel in isolated Joomla before claiming publication.
Any JED submission remains a separate authorized external/catalog process.
